personal-introduction:
I am {{age}} years old, a Computer Engineer and Full-Stack Developer with extensive experience building complex web systems, desktop apps, and developing hardware/firmware. I have strong expertise in C#/.NET, TypeScript/Angular, SQL, and other modern technologies.

I work on developing advanced solutions for Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) used by highway concessionaires across Brazil, such as platforms for real-time highway management, incidents, and service requests, self-service kiosks, and modules for real-time communication via video and text.

I have always been passionate about technology and naturally curious. I am a proactive and detail-oriented professional, focused on building scalable applications, collaboratively solving problems, and always willing to learn more and go beyond.

As a hobby, I am also interested in 3D, both 3D art (especially using Blender) and 3D printing; both of which I have experience with.
about-this-website-info:
This personal website is where you can find my info and some of my projects (related to software, hardware and engineering), and see some of the artwork of questionable quality I've created in my spare time. Here you can also find links to my socials and see my contact info. Feel free to check out my work and reach out if you have any questions, opportunities or inquiries, both personal and professional.

The website was built from scratch by me, using Angular v22, TypeScript and Sass (SCSS). For some of the components and theming, I used Angular Material. For internationalization and localization I am using Transloco. The source code of the website is on GitHub. Feel free to make suggestions and contributions, or fork the repository to use as a template, just credit me with the proper attribution.
